career_ladder.note: Line Attendant (Paricharak Line / परिचारक लाइन) is the frontline technical operative cadre in Chhattisgarh State Power Holding Company Limited (CSPHCL) and its operating subsidiaries: Chhattisgarh State Power Distribution Company Limited (CSPDCL) and Chhattisgarh State Power Transmission Company Limited (CSPTCL). Appointees execute 11 kV / 33 kV distribution and extra-high-voltage line patrolling, transformer maintenance, earthing, fault rectifications, and overhead line climbing. Promotion progression is governed by CSPHCL Technical & Subordinate Service Regulations, transitioning from Grade-III through Grade-I, leading into supervisory and junior engineering cadres upon qualifying departmental trade tests.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Line Attendant (Paricharak Line) is conducted directly by CSPHCL / CSPDCL through a two-stage evaluation methodology. Stage 1 involves merit compilation based on normalized Class 10 (Matriculation) academic percentage plus service bonus marks for candidates possessing verified contractual line experience in state power companies. Shortlisted candidates in a 1:3 ratio are called for Stage 2, comprising Document Verification and the mandatory Physical Efficiency Pole Climbing Test (8 to 9 meter electric distribution pole climbing with safety harness within prescribed time). The pole climbing test is strictly qualifying in nature; inability to climb the pole results in immediate elimination.

financial_package.note: Line Attendants are remunerated under CSPHCL Wage Scales at Pay Matrix Level S-1 (₹14,800 – ₹33,000) with entry basic pay of ₹14,800. Under Chhattisgarh State direct recruitment service regulations, newly recruited personnel undergo a 3-year probationary training period with phased stipend progression (1st year: 70% of scale minimum = ₹10,360; 2nd year: 80% = ₹11,840; 3rd year: 90% = ₹13,320) plus applicable dearness and field allowances, upon completion of which regular Pay Matrix Level S-1 is drawn.
financial_package.pay_source_label: CSPHCL / CSPTCL Recruitment Notice No. 01-01/HR-VIII/I/569995/2026 (Pay-scale S-1)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on full regular entry basic pay of ₹14,800 with project standard 58% Dearness Allowance (₹8,584), House Rent Allowance (6% to 9% as per city classification in Chhattisgarh = ₹888 to ₹1,332), and technical line hazard/patrol allowances; in-hand estimate deducts 10% NPS/CPF contribution (₹2,338), Group Insurance (GIS/APF), and state Professional Tax (₹150). During the initial 3-year probationary stipend regime (70%/80%/90%), entry in-hand stipend ranges between ₹16,000 and ₹19,000.

Contributory Provident Fund / National Pension System (NPS) with employer matching contribution
Safety equipment kit allowance (lineman safety belt, harness, insulated helmets, and gumboots)
Concessional domestic electricity quota for Chhattisgarh State Power Companies employees
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment benefits as per company service rules
